fixedCosts.derivation: 9 885 780 EUR long-term annual budget at the minimum nalet, excluding payroll, less the direct operating cost at that nalet: 600 h x 3 802 EUR (fixed-wing) + 600 h x 812 EUR (rotary) = 2 768 400 EUR. 9 885 780 - 2 768 400 = 7 117 380 EUR.

fixedCosts.derivation: 7 117 380 EUR organisation-level fixed cost allocated to the fixed-wing fleet by planned flight hours: 600 / (600 + 600) = 50 %. 7 117 380 x 0.5 = 3 558 690 EUR.
